questions.stem: In Rutherford's gold foil experiment, what did the observation that most alpha particles passed straight through the foil suggest?

options.text: The atom is mostly empty space
The nucleus is spread throughout the atom
The gold atoms were very soft

questions.explanation: Most alpha particles passed straight through the gold foil without being deflected, which showed that the atom is mostly empty space. If the positive charge were spread throughout the atom (as in the plum pudding model), all alpha particles would have been deflected.
